The first upload had an audio error that was 100% my fault, thank you for clicking again.

Synopsis:
In the near future, a towering alien "spike" materializes in Earth's atmosphere, wreaking havoc. Years later, it's still around. A struggling beekeeper is forced to team up with an emotionally raw EMT on a roadtrip to retrieve her bees (and his car) after their stuff is suddenly teleported across the country by the alien spike.

We're All Gonna Die (https://www.imdb.com/title/tt28055078/) premiered at SXSW in 2024 and then did a brief independent theatrical run. Since we self-financed it, we're putting it out on Blu-Ray and on YouTube, where the five midroll ads I have strategically placed will go towards our next project Nail House.

Promo cards voice over by Mike Badgley - https://mikebadgley.com/
